mapper.select: SELECT DEPT_NO, DEPT_NM, AUTH_NO, DEPT_SUPRR FROM TEAM3_202407F.DEPT ORDER BY DEPT_NO
SELECT POSITION_NO, POSITION_NM FROM TEAM3_202407F.POSITION ORDER BY POSITION_NO
SELECT USER_NO, STORE_NO, POSITION_NO, STORE_NM FROM TEAM3_202407F.STORE_EMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
SELECT USER_NO, POSITION_NO, EMP_MANAGER, DEPT_NO FROM TEAM3_202407F.EMPLOYEE WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}

SELECT u.USER_NO, u.USER_NM, u.USER_MAIL, u.USER_PHONE, u.USER_ADDR1, u.USER_ADDR2, u.USER_ZIP, e.DEPT_NO, d.DEPT_NM, e.POSITION_NO, p.POSITION_NM FROM TEAM3_202407F.TB_USER u LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.EMPLOYEE e ON u.USER_NO = e.USER_NO LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.DEPT d ON e.DEPT_NO = d.DEPT_NO LEFT JOIN TEAM3_202407F.POSITION p ON e.POSITION_NO = p.POSITION_NO WHERE u.USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAM3_202407F.TB_USER SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, USER_MAIL = #{userMail}, USER_PHONE = #{userPhone}, USER_ADDR1 = #{userAddr1}, USER_ADDR2 = #{userAddr2}, USER_ZIP = #{userZip} WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
